# AI-Ready Project Template

> Enterprise-Grade AI-Ready Template designed for deterministic, token-efficient, and security-hardened autonomous pair programming.

## Architecture & Specifications
- [docs/LOOP.md](docs/LOOP.md): Canonical Autonomous Loop v2.0 state machine, 9 operational pillars, and hard ceilings.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Core agent operational guidelines, 2-Tier Multi-Agent pipeline, and Karpathy behavioral invariants.
- [README.md](README.md): Repository overview, getting started, and container commands.

## Key Operational Invariants
- **2-Tier Multi-Agent Pipeline**: Layer 1 GPT Architect (strategic blueprint & compact assertions) + Layer 2 Gemini 3.8 Flash (native code synthesis & deterministic CPU execution).
- **Anti-Token-Drain**: $0 CPU verification (`npm test`), 32 KiB byte-capped command output, hard cap of 1 retry on test failure.
- **Protected Eval Zone**: `.eval/golden_assertions.json` is read-only and locked by SHA-256 checksum.
- **Execution Isolation**: When `kins_autonomous_sandbox` is active, all shell operations run inside Docker.

## Key Commands
- `npm test`: Clean, build, and execute deterministic test suite.
- `npm run typecheck`: Strict TypeScript type checking without emitting files.
- `npm run test:ai`: Run test suite through byte-capped runner (32 KiB cap).
- `docker exec kins_autonomous_sandbox npm test`: Isolated test execution inside container sandbox.
